name: gleaner
description: Gather the best of what you read into tagged, searchable clips. Save whole pages, collected parts, or YouTube videos with timestamped key moments, with your notes, as a Markdown file in ChatGPT or an HTML file in Claude by default or to Google Drive, Notion, a Cowork project, your Claude Code project, or a private claude.ai artifact, from the Chrome side panel, the Claude Code desktop browser, or ChatGPT's connected Chrome tabs and Work browser. Shared local-first preferences manage save destinations and formats with optional Google Drive sync.
